reviews.text:
I can only thank Nacho for everything he's taught us. Because it hasn't just been dog training, it's been so much more: learning to understand our puppy, to give him love, and above all, to receive his. ❤️

Thank you, Nacho, for teaching us so much!

We are delighted with LealCan and especially with Juan. It has been a pleasure to have him help with Mango's training. We are very grateful for his time and patience in explaining everything to us. Mango had been bitten and was afraid of dogs. Now we enjoy walks much more.

Tania has been an amazing trainer and has helped me so much with Blanco. Since Blanco is my first dog, I had a lot to learn, and Tania guided us from the very beginning. She taught me everything from basic training and impulse control to understanding his behaviour, communicating with him, socialising with other dogs, and gradually working towards being comfortable off-leash.

What I appreciate most is that Tania didn’t just train Blanco — she also taught me how to better understand and communicate with my dog. Thanks to her guidance, I feel much more confident as a dog owner, and I can really see the progress in Blanco.

She is also very professional, punctual, patient, kind, and flexible with scheduling. She always adapted the training to what Blanco needed and was happy to help whenever we faced a new challenge.

I’m really grateful for all her help and would highly recommend Tania to anyone looking for a great dog trainer, especially first-time dog owners. 🐾❤️
Many thanks to Tania for the amazing work she's done with Duna. Thank you for giving me the tools to keep progressing with her and improving our walks and recall.

With Juan LealCan, things have gone very well. We've learned to give Bruce a more structured life, and his behavior has improved significantly thanks to routines, positive reinforcement, and prioritizing his well-being above all else. Now everyone at home enjoys the puppy he is.

Nacho, the trainer, is a true professional. He taught us, advised us, and in the classes he gave us, he helped us learn and understand our dog, Nova, much better. It's a pleasure to work with people like him; he's very approachable and you connect with him right away. He's a ten out of ten as a person and as a professional. Now it's time for us to put what we learned into practice.

We are incredibly grateful for Sara's work with Kira. With patience, affection, and amazing sensitivity, she understood Kira's fears and supported her at her own pace, always maintaining a positive attitude and gradually offering small gestures of trust that have led to significant changes. From day one, she achieved what seemed impossible: she won Kira's trust in just a few minutes. For us, she has been much more than a professional; she has been a close and essential support for the whole family. We wholeheartedly recommend her.

In a moment of true desperation, I started looking for dog trainers, and while reading reviews, I found you. Today, I want to leave my own review, hoping to help someone going through a similar situation.

Don't give up hope. Here you'll find truly skilled trainers, but above all, wonderful people.

In our case, Gloria has been a beacon of hope. After going to two previous trainers without success, she was the one who finally got us back on track. With her expertise, patience, and above all, the love and understanding she showed our dog, Paco, she brought about a radical change.

We reached a point of utter despair, not knowing what to do or how to cope, and thanks to her work, we've managed to turn things around completely. It's been a process, but today we can say that we're much better and enjoying our dog again.

The intervention of the ethologist, Raquel, was also essential. She has been incredibly kind, professional, and dedicated, helping us every step of the way and providing everything we needed to understand and address the situation.

We can only express our deepest gratitude to both of them. Thank you for your work, your patience, your perseverance, and for helping us when we felt there was no way out.

Without a doubt, we recommend you 100%. If you are going through a difficult time with your dog, don't give up hope. For us, finding you has been a game-changer. ❤️

Thanks to Nacho's help, we were able to quickly resolve Duna's adjustment problems, making both us and especially the dog much happier. Nacho was always a very friendly and professional person, working closely with the family and the dog.
Duna already misses him.

We are delighted with the work Juan has done with our dog Max. From practically the first session, we began to notice changes in his behavior, all thanks to a positive reinforcement approach. We are very grateful for his care and understanding. Thank you, Juan!

A huge thank you to LealCan and Enrique for their guidance every step of the way, and especially to Nacho for his time, patience, and dedication!

He has given us all the necessary tools to continue strengthening our bond with Pipa. We are so grateful!

❤️❤️❤️❤️
Thank you so much, Ana. Piston thanks you for your help. Now we're enjoying our walks. We'll see you soon and have fun again. Hugs and kisses

We are delighted with LealCan and, especially, with Gloria. She is helping us tremendously with our puppy, always with care, patience, and great professionalism. She gives us a lot of peace of mind and confidence, which is essential at this stage. Highly recommended.

Training with Juan has been fantastic. He understood Benji's needs and mine (along with Bumi's), and everything has been incredibly organic. Both Benji's and my progress has been quite rapid. Highly recommended.

We were so lucky to have Sara help us with our puppy Rocco. Sara taught us techniques to reinforce desired behaviors and redirect those that concerned us. Her kindness, patience, flexibility, and knowledge made this experience very pleasant and productive. Thank you so much, Sara!

We adopted a very scared puppy and they showed us how to handle him. They've been there for us every step of the way, answering all our questions.
They know how to handle both dogs and people.

I am grateful to the LealCan team for all the information and support they have given us in understanding the behavior of our newly adopted pet and learning how to care for her as well as she deserves. Seeing Ana working with our puppy at home, with patience and professionalism, teaching us to recognize her signals... is priceless. Thanks to Ana, Raquel, and LealCan, our little dog is growing up much happier.

A professional company that works with all kinds of dogs and cats too (I only recently found out!), bringing out the best in them with great empathy and genuine care. If you need help with your furry friend, contact them—you won't regret it!
Thanks again, guys! 😘😘😘😘😘
We're doing great with Kira, we're super happy, we don't need anything else

We've spent the whole week with Ana, and we loved it. She's incredibly friendly and kind, and she was so affectionate with Nala. She explained everything so well, and we're thrilled. We'll definitely see her again after August. Thank you so much for everything; you do an amazing job!
